criteria.text: Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.

Identifies the threatened $450,000 claim by Juniper Capital LLP recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.

Identifies that the Corrib Foods Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($1,650,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
Lists the Corrib Foods Ltd change-of-control consent as a required third-party consent and states it has not been obtained.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
